answer: A reef of shared stake anchors every agent: joining deposits into a communal reef bond that every member loses a slice of when one member is caught cloning, so honest neighbours police each other. A summit committee of randomly rotated auditors verifies work samples each round, and its verdicts ride on zephyr tokens, light short-lived attestations that expire within one epoch, so a sybil cannot stockpile old approvals to fake a long history. Forging depth costs real stake plus fresh audits every round.
